acceptance_meaning: 'accepted' means this audit executed correctly on every recorded row of every verified input bundle. It does NOT mean the audited runs are stable; see the per-run verdicts.
config_interpretation: A failing row or run is stability-unverified, not unstable. The frozen-coefficient model freezes the measured velocity maxima over the whole grid and omits the variable-coefficient commutators, the axis row, the wall rows, the per-stage elliptic solve and the zeroth-order production terms; a failure is grounds for suspicion and for re-running at a smaller step, never a proof that a recorded trajectory grew. Acceptance of this bundle means the audit executed correctly, not that the audited runs are stable. Nothing here is evidence for or against singularity formation.
description: Frozen-coefficient von Neumann audit of every recorded operating point of the shipped Heun bundles hou_early_time_v1, hou_early_time_v2_hires and hou_time_refinement_v1. Each diagnostics row supplies max_abs_u_r, max_abs_u_z, dt and viscosity; the grid spacings are dr = r_max/(nr-1) and dz = z_period/nz with r_max = 1 and z period 1. Every row is scanned with ns_certificate_lab.von_neumann.audit_snapshot for the Heun full step and its explicit-Euler predictor stage over a 721x721 wavenumber sample, and each run (one nr x nz of the resolution series, one refinement level of the time-refinement series) receives a verdict computed from its own rows. The audited bundles record one diagnostic row every 25 accepted steps, so the audit covers the recorded rows and nothing between them.
interpretation: Frozen-coefficient von Neumann audit applied to the recorded operating points of shipped Heun runs. A failing row or run is stability-unverified, not unstable: the model freezes the measured velocity maxima over the whole grid and omits the variable-coefficient commutators, the axis row (E-17 coefficient-8 limit), the wall rows (E-27/E-31), the per-stage elliptic solve and the zeroth-order production terms, so a failure is grounds for suspicion and for a smaller step and never a proof that a recorded trajectory grew. A passing run is verified only AT THE RECORDED ROWS: the audited bundles record one diagnostic row every stride accepted steps and the steps in between were never written down, so no number here covers them. Nothing in this bundle is evidence for or against singularity formation.
limitations: STRIDE. Only the recorded diagnostic rows are audited; the audited bundles record one row every 25 accepted steps, and the roughly 24 steps between two records carry their own dt, max|u^r| and max|u^z|, none of which were written down. No verdict here covers them. The per-step step_stream instrumentation closes this gap for future runs only.

FROZEN COEFFICIENTS. The measured velocity maxima are frozen over the whole grid. Frozen-coefficient analysis discards the commutator terms, so it is neither an upper nor a lower bound for the variable-coefficient operator that the solver actually applied.

BOUNDARY ROWS. The axis row (E-17 coefficient-8 limit) and the wall rows (E-27/E-31) are boundary modifications of the stencil. No Fourier mode diagonalizes them and nothing in this bundle says anything about them; the frozen 3*nu/r first-derivative term is a proxy, not the axis row.

OMITTED OPERATORS. The per-stage elliptic solve -L5 psi1 = omega1 and the zeroth-order production terms 2 u1 psi1_z and d_z(u1^2) are not modelled, which makes the model optimistic in those directions.

SAMPLED SUPREMUM. Each scan maximizes over a finite 721x721 wavenumber sample containing theta = 0 and theta = +/-pi exactly, so every reported max|G| is a lower bound for the true frozen-coefficient supremum.
ACCEPTANCE. 'accepted' in this bundle means the audit executed correctly on every recorded row. It does NOT mean the audited runs are stable.

method.exclusions: rows whose recorded dt is exactly zero are step-0 records with no step taken; they are excluded and counted
method.operating_point: the recorded max_abs_u_r and max_abs_u_z of each diagnostics row are frozen over the whole grid and fed in simultaneously, with dr = r_max/(nr-1) and dz = z_period/nz
method.predictor_stage: the explicit-Euler predictor of Heun is scanned separately, because a stage can overflow even when the completed step does not
method.run_verdict_rule: stability-verified-at-recorded-rows if every audited row of the run passes at the configured tolerance, otherwise stability-unverified

runs.label: hou_early_time_v1
runs.strided_growth_extrapolation_note: exp(sum over recorded rows of ln(max|G|) * stride). The per-step amplification factors of the steps between two recorded rows were never recorded, so this expression assumes each recorded row's frozen worst case persisted unchanged for its whole stride. That is a strided extrapolation, not a bound, in either direction.
runs.verdict_meaning: stability-unverified means the frozen-coefficient worst case was not verified at one or more recorded rows; it is grounds for suspicion and for a smaller step, not a proof that the run was unstable. stability-verified-at-recorded-rows covers the recorded rows only.

runtime.scans_note: one full-step and one predictor-stage scan per audited row, each over a 721x721 wavenumber sample

axial_binding.reading: the recorded advective CFL is carried by the axial direction

shipped_reference_points.note: the verdict of the shipped operating point turns in the fifth to sixth significant digit and depends on which direction is assumed to carry the recorded CFL; the per-run numbers in this bundle use the recorded max|u^r| and max|u^z| of each row simultaneously and are therefore at least as pessimistic as the radial-binding reading
shipped_reference_points.operating_point: the self-consistent reading of outputs/hou_early_time_v1 (min dt = 2.7587e-7, max advective CFL = 0.10023) at tolerance 1e-12

radial_binding.reading: the recorded advective CFL is carried by the radial direction
